objective: Determine whether the current public Vela contract can retain one exact foreign accepted Claim and its source authority evidence in a second Frontier without changing local Standing.
required_foreign_reference_bindings: source Proposal or Decision ID and root

decision_rule.gap_reproduced: Any required binding or public non-escalating transfer surface is absent.
decision_rule.unsafe_reuse: A migration-only or local-authority field would need semantic rebinding to simulate transfer.

implementation_ceiling: Do not add a hosted service, Registry, global namespace, resolver, graph database, or second writer.
Do not reinterpret repository-epoch migration fields as federation.
Do not implement a protocol primitive before the real source correction is terminal and two independent readers reproduce the gap.
